Sales performance: where the money leaks

50,000 orders, Jan 2024 to 27 Sep 2026. Synthetic practice dataset (not real company data). Revenue and profit count delivered orders only; cancelled and returned orders are treated as leakage.

Monthly revenue and profit

Problem 1: deep discounts destroy profit

Profit by discount level, all orders in the filter. Red bars are net losses; the line is the share of orders that lose money.

Category: revenue vs margin

Margin = realized profit / delivered revenue.

What-if: cap the maximum discount

Orders above the cap are repriced at the cap. Cost per order stays the same. Some of those buyers may not purchase at the higher price; use the second slider to test that risk.
